privacy.metaDescription: How Tu Chamba collects, uses and protects your personal data when you use the job board.
privacy.title: Privacy Policy

whoWeAre.title: Who we are
whoWeAre.body: Tu Chamba is a Bolivian job board operated by Grupo CorpSC. If you have any questions about this policy or about your data, email us at <mail>{email}</mail>.

dataCollected.title: What data we collect
dataCollected.account: Your account details: name, email address and phone number (optional). Your password is stored encrypted; if you sign in with Google, we don't store a password.
dataCollected.listings: Listings you post: description, salary, location and any contact phone number you choose to include.
dataCollected.activity: Activity on the site: listing views (in aggregate), the listings you show interest in when you get in touch, your reviews and your notifications.

purposes.title: How we use it
purposes.item1: To run the site: posting listings, searching and getting in touch.
purposes.item2: To show a listing's phone number and location only to signed-in users.
purposes.item3: To notify you of relevant activity (people interested in your listings, reviews you receive, expiring listings, and any job alerts you set up).
purposes.item4: To moderate reported content and prevent spam.

sharing.title: Who we share data with
sharing.p1: We don't sell your data or share it with third parties for advertising purposes. A listing's phone number and location are shown to registered users, because that's the whole point of the site: letting people contact you. Contact via WhatsApp or phone call happens outside Tu Chamba, directly between the people involved.
sharing.p2: If you sign in with Google, Google confirms your email address to us in accordance with its own privacy policy.

retention.title: How long we keep it
retention.body: For as long as your account exists. If you delete your account, your listings, interests, alerts and notifications are deleted too. Reviews you wrote are deleted along with your account.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.body: You can view and correct your details from My profile, delete your listings from My listings and remove listings from your interest list. To delete your account or exercise any other right over your data, email us at {email}.

changes.title: Changes to this policy
changes.body: If we change this policy, we'll update the date on this page. Significant changes will be announced on the site.

cookies.metaDescription: Which cookies and local storage Tu Chamba uses, and why.
cookies.title: Cookie Policy

essentials.title: The essentials
essentials.body: Tu Chamba doesn't use advertising cookies or third-party tracking cookies. We only use the storage that is strictly necessary for the site to work.

stored.title: What we store in your browser
stored.tokenPurpose: Keeps you signed in. It's deleted when you sign out.
stored.googleType: Third party (only if you use it)
stored.googlePurpose: If you choose "Continue with Google", Google may use its own cookies to authenticate you, in line with its policy.

notDone.title: What we DON'T do
notDone.item1: We don't use advertising or remarketing cookies.
notDone.item2: We don't share your browsing with ad networks.
notDone.item3: Listing views are counted in aggregate on our server, without identifying you through cookies.

control.title: How to control it
control.body: You can clear local storage from your browser settings (doing so will sign you out). If you have any questions, email us at <mail>{email}</mail>.
